entries.label: Ahab · NECA SDCC2014
sourceToA: SDCC2014 broad silver crown, three forehead claw scars, turquoise/blue patina, dark eyes and cheek sockets remain recognizable.
Open lower aperture is empty after wearer mouth/tusks removal. Published detached-mask concept supports the rigid rim versus biological mouth separation.
AtoB: Same crown, scars, open U aperture and silver/turquoise regions; B smooths coarse grain and clarifies metal without closing the aperture.
entries.cavityAndWearerReview: Open lower U area verified alpha0 in both versions.
localLimitations: Rim notch count, small socket hardware and individual paint chips remain interpreted rather than exact sculpture evidence.
Near-front source pose is slightly regularized/centered; neither exact3D camera nor full comics Ahab design is established.

ABStability.metricScope: Generated B versus generated A stability only, never canonical/photo geometry proof.

overallDecision: All seven pairs suitable as reviewable candidates with explicit edition/source limitations; no major correction requested.
commonLimitations: A is a newly generated interpretation of the visible licensed photo sculpture and paint, not a pixel-exact crop of R or proof of the film/comic/game original.
Tiny grooves, pits, hardware, vent/ridge counts and occluded boundaries remain interpreted; source image size and lighting limit any1:1 claim.
Near-front source poses are sometimes slightly centered/straightened and symmetry regularized; no calibrated3D camera or hidden geometry is established.
B stabilizes broad design/palette against generated A; automatic alpha/aspect metrics cannot establish canonical fidelity or human art approval.

browserEvidence.method: Original reference and native candidate bytes served locally. Browser CSS scales/displays manual source windows and alpha16 bounding boxes for comparison. No candidate/source pixel crop, recolor, resize or re-encode is saved.
